findings.detail: The companyfacts_fv anchor used 13.958 million from the Companies 5% to 25% owned balance-sheet line instead of total investments of 420.568 million.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the extracted fair value sum of 420.568 million matches the filing schedule total and the fair-value hierarchy total. The disputed companyfacts anchor of 13.958 million is visible in the balance sheet as only the Companies 5% to 25% owned subline, not total investments. The conservation failure is therefore a false alarm caused by a bad anchor, not a source-backed holdings error.
